headline: OpenAI has hired Thomas Lind, a former White House cyber and AI policy official, to lead cyber and strategic risk work on its national security policy team.
score_reason: Lowered from 5 to 4: the headline says top Trump AI official, but he left the White House in June 2026 and the role is a team lead.
importance_line: It adds a former White House cyber and AI policy adviser to OpenAI's national security staff while regulators probe AI dangers, but a single hire shows little about OpenAI's plans.
summary: PYMNTS, citing The Information, reports that Thomas Lind, who led AI policy at the White House's Office of the National Cyber Director until June 2026, joined OpenAI this week to lead cyber and strategic risk on its national security policy team. OpenAI's national security policy head, Sasha Baker, told The Information that the hire shows OpenAI is continuing to invest in handling the national security risks of increasingly capable AI.
notes: Original outlet The Information (https://www.theinformation.com/articles/openai-hires-top-trump-ai-official-work-national-security) is paywalled; wrote from PYMNTS' report of it, so source and url are PYMNTS'. Lind left the White House in June 2026, so 'top Trump AI official' overstates his current standing.
